en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Chapter on the Propped-Up Position 28.
The Training Rule on Receiving with the Awareness of the Bowl.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks received almsfood while looking here and there; they did not even know when it was being poured out or when it had passed by... [etc. ...
"The training is to be observed: 'I will receive almsfood with mindfulness directed to the bowl.
Almsfood is to be received with mindfulness directed to the bowl."
If one, out of disrespect, receives almsfood while looking here and there, there is an offense of wrong-doing. There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first offender":
the eighth training rule is concluded.
